name: Lock gate (Kestrel Lock)
notes: One leaf of oak and iron that shuts a canal lock's 6 m channel, 3.3 m tall so its top stays a hand below the lock beam walk (mw-e25.14). It swings on its hinge over 8 seconds, slow because it pushes water, and is worked by hand from the beam walk. It carries no lock: the water is the lock. A scene ties it to the chamber's liquid volume with `door.interlock`, so it jams while the levels differ and a player who tries it hears and sees it strain. Water, light and sound pass a lock gate's seams, so it blocks none of them.
